_comment: c8 coverage configuration for the spec repo's runtime TypeScript surface.
Deliberately out of scope (verified by other gates, not by c8):

- examples/**/*.ts                              scaffold and fixture code shipped to adopters; not run by the spec repo. Compiles via `npm --prefix tools run typecheck:examples`, which proves the templates type-check without requiring that we execute them.
- tools/tests/**                                test files do not measure themselves.
- collector-types.ts, validator-types.ts       interface-only files; including them would dilute the percentage with uncoverable type declarations.
Unknown keys (this _comment) are ignored by c8.
